about: Threshold: whether the field strength at Finland's outer limit is over the trigger level of ECC T/R 25-08 for the station's band.
bands_basis: ECC Recommendation T/R 25-08 (amended 6 June 2025), Annex 1, A1.2.3: co-channel trigger levels at the border, 10% of time, 50% of locations, 10 m receiving antenna, in a 25 kHz reference bandwidth. Above 470 MHz the level for 400–470 MHz is used, as Traficom said on 7 November 2026.
bandwidth_correction: 10·log10(bandwidth / 25 kHz) is added for a channel wider than 25 kHz (T/R 25-08).
near_basis: Administration policy: within 3 dB under the trigger level is a near miss.
coordinated: Finland has completed coordination (fxm_coord with adm FIN, a status containing COMPLETED and none containing REQUIRED).

outcomes.over: Its signal at Finland's border is over the trigger level.
outcomes.over_coordinated: Its signal is over the trigger level, but Finland has completed coordination for it. This is a case to verify, not a closed one.
outcomes.near: Its signal is under the trigger level, but within 3 dB of it.
outcomes.under: Its signal at Finland's border is under the trigger level by more than 3 dB.
